t_advice_summary_textbox.text: 8 colours of gnomes in two sets and each set has a coloured basket. Blue yellow green and orange open an orange basked and red purple pink and brown open a red basket. Keep going for the same set of gnomes until the number of mushrooms goes down and then start picking the other set of colour gnomes

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 different coloured gnomes and 2 different coloured baskets. The first set is blue, green, yellow and orange gnomes which open a yellow basket and the second set which is brown, pink, red and purple open a red basket. Keep clicking on one set of gnomes until the value of the mushrooms goes really low and then click on the next set. Keep switching through between sets to get the most points. It is some trial and error still though and I found brown, purple and blue to be quite high scorers. Also take good use of the breaks.
